text:
kelly-partners: Partner ask: VXCloud (marketplace/hardware integrator) wants a concise SEV path doc we can share — they keep getting routed to general support and it's slow. Can we agree on a canonical shared-channel + paging flow?

mike-eng: Short answer: yes. We should standardize a 4-step flow: shared channel, war room, partner SE page, exec loop. Keep it one page they can bookmark.

zoe-sre: I can draft a minimal flow. Proposed roles: incident lead (Redwood SRE), partner liaison (Partner SE), eng triage (Redwood Eng), support comms (Redwood Support). Also include an explicit hardware on-call contact when partner is a hardware vendor.

kelly-partners: VXCloud provided contacts: vx-se@vxcloud.com, vx-ops@vxcloud.com, vx-exec@vxcloud.com. They asked that we use an alias for pages so they don't have to update recipients.

partner-bot: Created channel #partners-vxcloud-sev and pinned partners/sev-template.md

tim-support: Suggest we add a customer-comms template snippet: impact, ETA, mitigation, contact. Keeps messages consistent across partners.

mike-eng: Technical mitigation template: fallback route (region failover), temporary SKU defaults, and a kill-switch for automated provisioning. We'll add quick commands to the runbook.

zoe-sre: Escalation timings proposal: T0 create war room + triage; T+10m contact partner SE + request logs; T+20m page partner exec if unresolved; T+40m open customer bridge and run mitigations.

kelly-partners: VXCloud liked the alias idea. I'll own outreach to confirm aliases and sign-off on the doc. Can we get this into the partners-runbook as a short section?

zoe-sre: I'll open a PR to partners/runbook.md with a new subsection "Canonical partner SEV flow" and attach the one-page PDF. Will include a checklist: create shared channel, assign roles, paste contact aliases, pin runbook, open war room link, and set pager thresholds.

mike-eng: One more ask: include a small decision table for when to fallback to our hosted variants vs waiting for partner fix. Saves time in war rooms.

kelly-partners: Great. I'll follow up with VXCloud and loop back when aliases are confirmed. Thanks — short retro in 24h after any first SEV will validate the flow.
